0.original: The fishmonger's feathers are fluffed in anticipation of Pashenine's return.

1.original: Donuhanu has asked that you procure raging Hanuheads to help Pashenine regain his strength.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Raging Hanuheads can be fished from Eastbound Zorgor using dragonflies as bait.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Minimum collectability rating for this delivery is 228. Delivering items with a rating of 535 or more will earn greater rewards.

2.original: You deliver raging Hanuheads to Donuhanu. Replenished of fighting spirit, Pashenine is now ready to attempt his trial again and fulfill his rite of passage. Stand by your fish-loving friends till the end!

24.original: Catch raging Hanuheads in Eastbound Zorgor and deliver them to Donuhanu.

48.original: In order to undertake this quest, you must first complete the main scenario quest “The Long Road to Xak Tural.”

49.original: Any moment now and Pashenine should be back with news...

50.original: There he is─ahoy! Pashenine, the fearless fish fighter!

51.original: Pray, do not call me fearless, Donuhanu. I fled from that vile carnivorous tree, and come here now in disgrace...

52.original: My brethren reassured me that I may undertake the trial again, but...

53.original: ...I cannot for the life of me imagine what fish might fell the dread beast. It cast aside the cenote shark as though it were a mere minnow.

54.original: There, there, lad. We'll find you another fish─never you fear.

55.original: In the meantime, let's get something in your belly, eh? Nothing lifts the spirits like a fancy feast!

56.original: Say, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>─do you have a permit to travel into Xak Tural?

57.original: Excellent! There's a fascinatin' fish in Shaaloani that's said to refresh and rejuvenate. Nothin' better to perk up our pal Pashenine, I'd say!

59.original: The very same! You're familiar with ol' Madhead, then?

60.original: I've never seen one in person, but I've heard they resemble Hanuhanu. And that they migrate from the water into the sky upon maturity.

61.original: An indomitable fish─a fish of substance! We need six of them, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Cross the bridge to Shaaloani and cast your line into Eastbound Zorgor. And don't forget dragonflies for your bait!

63.original: This nation may be facin' its own troubles, but no matter how dire the straits, we stand by our friends. And our fish!

64.original: What could be better than havin' a fish twin? Toss a dragonfly or two into Eastbound Zorgor and reel us in some ragin' Hanuheads, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

65.original: After all the help you've given me, I still failed. I'm so sorry...

66.original: Ho ho! So <hex:021A020203>this<hex:021A020103> is the famous ragin' Hanuhead, eh? Handsome, handsome!

67.original: Well, I'll be finned and scaled! In all my years of mongerin' fish, I've never seen a finer fellow than the ragin' Hanuhead!

68.original: Remarkably rotund! Yes, a fine resemblance indeed.

69.original: I first heard about the raging Hanuhead from a traveling Pelupelu merchant. In virtue of our close ties to nature, we Whalaqee are always keen to hear of new and unusual creatures, you see.

70.original: Apparently, their eggs are laid in freshwater lakes, but once hatchlings reach maturity, they leap into the clouds by way of the waterspouts created by hellsnow sharks.

71.original: At first I thought it odd that a Xak Turali fish was named for a Yok Turali peoples.

72.original: But perhaps a traveler like that merchant found its shape reminiscent of a people who left an unforgettable impression, and so fondly named the creature.

73.original: Be it of Xak Tural or Yok Tural─that's a fish that'll soothe your spirits and strengthen your resolve.

74.original: I'll leave the cookin' to you, Pashenine─though don't mind me studyin' your technique as you do. If there's a trick to makin' heavenly catches even heavenlier, our customers need to know!

75.original: Let's have ourselves a ragin' feast, eh?

77.original: Would you care for a serving of raging Hanuhead, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?

80.original: I-I just ate. Maybe next time...

81.original: Understood. I'll get straight to work.

82.original: Here we are... Raging Hanuhead soup.

84.original: The meat had a fluffier texture than I imagined. A result of its aerial habitat, perhaps?

85.original: Without a doubt! Happy is the man who sups on fresh catches...even if they do look slightly like him.

86.original: Thanks for fetchin' us this treat, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Now that Pashenine's got color in his cheeks, we can see about fishin' for his final challenge. Old Donuhanu's just got to give it a good think, and he'll be sure to come up with somethin'...

87.original: Donuhanu is thrilled with your efforts. He now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Phenomenal Fish Finder<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

88.original: A new quest continuing the story of Fish Fancies Donuhanu is now available. Speak with Donuhanu as a fisher at level 100 or above to undertake the quest.

89.original: In order to complete the subsequent quest, you must first complete the main scenario quest “Drowned Vestiges.”
